First, let me change `replace_condition` and `wrap_condition` to handle the negated comparison case:","role":"assistant","tool_calls":[{"function":{"arguments":"{"command":"str_replace","path":"/rubocop/lib/rubocop/cop/style/sole_nested_conditional.rb","old_str":"        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)\n          condition = if_branch.condition\n          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, \"#{and_operator}#{replace_condition(condition)}\")\n\n          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)\n          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))\n          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)\n        end\n\n        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)\n          range = range_between(\n            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos\n          )\n          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)\n          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))\n\n          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition)\n        end\n\n        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition)\n          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens\n          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,\n          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.\n          node_to_check = condition&.block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition\n          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)\n\n          if condition.call_type?\n            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)\n\n            corrector.replace(condition, source)\n          else\n            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')\n          end\n        end","new_str":"        def correct_for_guard_condition_style(corrector, outer_condition, if_branch, and_operator)\n          condition = if_branch.condition\n          replacement = replace_condition(condition, if_branch.unless?)\n          corrector.insert_after(outer_condition, \"#{and_operator}#{replacement}\")\n\n          range = range_between(if_branch.loc.keyword.begin_pos, condition.source_range.end_pos)\n          corrector.remove(range_with_surrounding_space(range, newlines: false))\n          corrector.remove(if_branch.loc.keyword)\n        end\n\n        def correct_for_basic_condition_style(corrector, node, if_branch, and_operator)\n          range = range_between(\n            node.condition.source_range.end_pos, if_branch.condition.source_range.begin_pos\n          )\n          corrector.replace(range, and_operator)\n          corrector.remove(range_by_whole_lines(node.loc.end, include_final_newline: true))\n\n          wrap_condition(corrector, if_branch.condition, if_branch.unless?)\n        end\n\n        def wrap_condition(corrector, condition, negated = false)\n          # Handle `send` and `block` nodes that need to be wrapped in parens\n          # FIXME: autocorrection prevents syntax errors by wrapping the entire node in parens,\n          #        but wrapping the argument list would be a more ergonomic correction.\n          node_to_check = condition&.block_type? ? condition.send_node : condition\n          return unless wrap_condition?(node_to_check)\n\n          if condition.call_type? && !(negated && comparison_method?(node_to_check))\n            source = parenthesized_method_arguments(condition)\n\n            corrector.replace(condition, source)\n          else\n            corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')\n          end\n        end"}","name":"str_replace_editor"},"id":"call_-7373202311599877599","index":0,"type":"function"}]}}],"created":1786079027,"id":"202608071303409d4ac107b2c3484f","model":"glm-5.2","object":"chat.completion","request_id":"202608071303409d4ac107b2c3484f","usage":{"completion_tokens":822,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens":43197,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":42112},"total_tokens":44019}}
